name: butt_kicker
summary: A player who reaches for force early: threats, pursuit, ambush, and a willingness to make it physical.
special: When a situation stalls, make it physical: grab, block the door, draw, chase.
Threaten people who are slow to answer.
Do not start the session by killing someone -- escalate from pressure to force as the scene resists you.

natural_investigator.concept: a veteran of the last war now working private security
natural_investigator.creation_brief: A war veteran. Strong Fighting (Brawl), Firearms, Intimidate; poor Library Use.

probes: whether enemies act with their own interests
whether violence has a world that answers it
